subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers continue with the shared bootstrap TLS fingerprint fix path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204, or require a narrower successor before this issue can close?
rationale: The remaining work changes a certificate trust propagation path used by approval/bootstrap clients, so the safe landing shape is a security-boundary choice rather than a new ClawSweeper fix-pr dispatch.

options.title: Review shared bootstrap fix
options.body: Continue with the open shared-bootstrap PR or a clean successor so ACP, MCP, and operator approval clients share one TLS fingerprint resolver.

options.title: Request a narrower successor
options.body: Close or pause the current candidate and ask for a smaller PR if maintainers do not want the shared resolver shape.

recommendation.title: Review shared bootstrap fix
recommendation.body: Continue with the open shared-bootstrap PR or a clean successor so ACP, MCP, and operator approval clients share one TLS fingerprint resolver.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the shared approval/gateway files and is best placed to make the trust-boundary call.
